data.name: Canoe Rentals
data.headline: Ages 18+ • Hourly Rentals
data.description: Nestled within McArthur-Burney Falls Memorial State Park, the marina offers easy access to calm waters perfect for paddling. Whether you're looking to explore the shoreline, spot local wildlife, or enjoy a peaceful day on the lake, our canoes provide a fun and relaxing way to experience the outdoors. They are available by the hour or day—no experience necessary. Come enjoy the natural splendor of Burney Falls from the water!
data.what_is_included: Rentals include paddles and life jackets
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 72 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to inquire about cancellations. No-shows will be charged the full price
